channel.title: Rajath Pai, writing
channel.description: Short write-ups of ML competitions and notes, each ending with what to reuse.

item.title: ARC-AGI-3: I Built the Lab; the Score Came from a Public Notebook
item.description: 31.86 is a public notebook plus my startup fix. Here’s the offline lab I built around it.

item.title: Kaggriculture: How Switching On One Disabled Setting Beat the Public Bots
item.description: 786 of 10,148. The whole ladder ran one shared action tape.

item.title: The Silver Medal I Didn't Pick: RSNA Knee
item.description: Top 12 %, no medal. An unselected blend was silver; I picked finals by the public board alone.

item.title: Pokémon TCG AI: Search Can't Fix a Bad Value Function
item.description: Strategy write-up: a search agent beat itself 97 %, then lost 1–15 to a rule bot.

item.title: Symbolic Search Scored 0 on ARC-AGI-2 Eval
item.description: Weeks on 19 families of rule-finders: about 6 % of training tasks, none of the evaluation set.

item.title: Orbit Wars: Self-Play Lied, a Stronger Base Won
item.description: 505 of 4,729. Self-play wins failed on the ladder; adopting a stronger public agent didn’t.

item.title: Docker Layers, Registries and S3, Explained
item.description: A beginner-friendly explanation of Docker layers, checksums, manifests, registries, and how they compare to storing tarballs in S3.

item.title: ARC Prize 2025: Solving Puzzles With No Pretraining
item.description: 124 of 1,455 (top 9 %) with a per-puzzle CompressARC solver fitted into 12 hours.

item.title: Teaching DeBERTa to Read Student Math Mistakes
item.description: Misconception prediction from written explanations; the starter notebook has 105+ upvotes.

item.title: Finding Data in the Footnotes with Constrained Decoding
item.description: 186 of 1,282. Regex finds dataset DOIs; an LLM with one-token decoding classifies them.
